notes.title: Selection menu cosmetics and revision of some shots.
notes.content:
Hello, a few minor changes in Nanoforce.
1 The menu has been redesigned so that the player knows which game mode they are entering: in Arcade mode, the color is orange, in Story mode, it is blue, and in "Green" mode, it is naturally green.
When the player remains on the "Story" tab or on the "B-plan," text is displayed to clarify the story and add initial context.

2, I made some slight modifications to two sets: the "retractors" and the "needle driver," by adding a new texture and a slight "homing" effect to the front shot of the needle driver, and two additional firing points to the seeker shot of the retractors.

notes.title: Weapons and gameplay in NANOFORCE
notes.content:
I know the weapon system in Nanoforce can seem hard to handle at first play BUT It's very easy!!!!


The player is carrying the grasper set composed with 4 weapons, for example, If you play with a Xbox pad, you can shot (as you want and full power)  back and front with X, Homing pressing the Y button and A is the one to use special weapons (unlimited use and also full power it reduce the ship's speed a bit)


Then if you collect other items (showed here )

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43701199/1f2cacf49c74c47c62f5986ac318882dc4f49cc6.png[/img]

The config remains the same about the pad but the grapser set is replace with "cranial drills", "needledriver"  "tissue distruptor" or "wave phaser".

All this news sets are using the same controls, but their weapons have different skins and behaviors...It's up to you to master them!

For example homming missiles will be replaced by two homing lasers or homing spores, frontal shot with a wider frontal weapon or a short range powerfull electric bolt..

there are other sets "exceptions", the OMNI and "scalpel" sets are composed with only one weapon but it can be fired in 4 direction Using ABXY buttons. if you want to shoot up, uses Y, down use A etc...
